findings.description: Do not allow attaching to shell on pods
findings.remediation: Create a role which does not permit attaching to shell on pods

findings.description: Do not allow users in a rolebinding to add other users to their rolebindings
findings.remediation: Create a role which does not permit allowing users in a rolebinding to add other users to their rolebindings if not needed

findings.description: Tiller Is Deployed
findings.remediation: Migrate to Helm v3 which no longer has Tiller component

findings.description: Containers must not set runAsUser to 0
findings.remediation: Set 'securityContext.runAsUser' to a non-zero integer or leave undefined.

findings.description: Container capabilities must only include NET_BIND_SERVICE
findings.remediation: Set 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop' to 'ALL' and only add 'NET_BIND_SERVICE' to 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add'.

findings.description: The deprecated 'apiVersion' and 'kind' should not be used
findings.remediation: Migrate resource to new API

findings.description: Prevent binding to privileged ports
findings.remediation: Do not map the container ports to privileged host ports when starting a container.

findings.description: Gatekeeper repo reference is ambiguously open-ended
findings.remediation: Apply secure configuration template.

findings.description: Automated DNS permutations executed (171 tests evaluated).
findings.remediation: Ensure storage containers maintain private access level.
